programmes.d: After acting too confident before a fight, Kid Danger and Captain Man are sprayed with Flabber Gas making them powerless to defeat a new villain in Swellview; Schwoz puts the heroes in Exo-Suits which Charlotte and Jasper control.

Captain Man reveals a Crime fighters Only room in the Man Cave; when Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up, the gang fights over who gets the better room and things get blown out of proportion.
When a report comes out that declares Kid Danger's superpower an illness, Kid Danger has to convince Swellview that it is a huge misunderstanding.
A 13-year-old boy lands a job as a sidekick to a superhero, and he must now keep his identity a secret.

Lincoln worries that he has lost his manliness from growing up with sisters, so he and Clyde decide to go camping; Lincoln gets Lori a job at a pizza arcade, but Lori gets in trouble when he starts to ask for favors.
During a road trip to their vacation destination, everything that can go wrong for the family does.

When the children hear Lily curse, they become worried that they have been a bad influence on her; when a love letter addressed to L. Loud arrives, the family tries to figure out who it was meant for.

Ronnie Anne makes friends with Sid, a girl whose family wants to rent the apartment upstairs; when it looks like another couple might get it first, the girls resort to sabotage to try and dissuade them.
Leni, the oldest in the house, struggles to follow in Lori's footsteps as the family's babysitter; secret agents Lincoln and Clyde investigate the Louds' suspicious new neighbors.
Lincoln has a plan for introducing himself to a new girl; Pop Pop introduces his new girlfriend to the family; she seems great until she starts showing up unannounced.
After agreeing to go to the Royal Woods House of Terror, Lincoln and Clyde have to toughen up and face their fears; Lola discovers that Lucy has an old, fragile doll and decides she must borrow it.

When Lincoln's mother signs him up for peewee football, Lincoln schemes to have Lynn take his spot; Lincoln becomes a hypochondriac when Lucy reads his fortune and predicts that his day will end in disaster.
Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day.
When Ronnie Anne and Bobby visit their crazy extended family, Bobby fits in great, but Ronnie Anne struggles with the smothering nature of their relatives.

When a high utility bill threatens Hector and Rosa's annual trip, Ronnie Anne spearheads an effort to lower usage; desperate for their own space, Ronnie Anne and Sid find a hidden room and try to keep it from the other tenants.
Lola does everything to stop Lana from planning their joint birthday party; Lincoln and the Middle School Action News Team solve a mystery.
Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob hide the health inspector's body; SpongeBob and Patrick throw out their new TV and keep the box.
Mr. Krabs sells his restaurant and goes into early retirement; Squidward convinces SpongeBob that he has a laugh-related illness.

To attend the Rat Bros' party, the trio tries to get their hands on the latest cool item: pogo sticks; Rock tries to get a job at Evil Robot Corp; Paper and Scissors see if the company is exactly what it sounds like.
After the heater breaks, the trio's apartment freezes; Paper tries to save his friends; Lou attends Landlord Con; Paper joins Rock and Scissors in a prank war against the Rat Bros and Pencil.

Timmy causes trouble for his favorite comic book hero, the Crimson Chin; Timmy's switches places with Vicky's dog.
Timmy wishes that all the food in the world were desserts; Timmy finds that playing with dolls leads to serious trouble.
